rulings.why: The page cannot tell these changes from the row: join:refrain.1.1: p594-strip0.jpg the refrain's first system: line 1 ends with an exclamation mark, so line 2's first word carries a capital anyway (lines 1 and 2 are printed with the same words); the header prints C.M.D. for the stanzas and only Ref. for the refrain, so no metre fixes the refrain's lines. join:refrain.1.2: p594-strip0.jpg the refrain's two systems: line 2 ends the first with an exclamation mark, and line 3's first word is the vocative O, capitalised either way; the refrain has no printed metre, so nothing tells the joined line from two.
